# Elvis Kwame Ofori

I am a PhD Researcher and Research Assistant at the University of Galway, working across agricultural economics, land-use modelling, climate and environmental policy, and quantitative decision support.

I develop economic, spatial, behavioural and computational models to examine how agricultural, land-use and bioenergy policies move from national objectives to real production systems and places: where adjustment occurs, who and what is exposed, which alternatives are feasible, and how different policy designs may perform before major decisions are locked in.
